entries.name: WalletBlastDoorSupport
entries.note: Support code for Apple Wallet and payment passes; BifrOSt has no Wallet or Apple Pay service.

entries.name: Wallpaper
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Wallpaper selection and day/night schedule in springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_schedule.rs and wallpaper_page.rs.

entries.name: WallpaperAnalytics
entries.note: Analytics for wallpaper use; BifrOSt does not mirror analytics collection.

entries.name: WallpaperExtensionKit
entries.note: Partial. Built: an app declares its wallpapers in its manifest and install checks them against the package (springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_types.rs). Built 2026-10-17: wallpaper_types::installed reads the installed manifests, and the shell caches each app's first picture as wallpapers/app_<id>.raw (springboard/src/bin/shell.rs app_wallpapers) so the Settings Wallpaper grid lists it and choosing it uses the still path (tests wallpaper_types::tests). Gap: a day wallpaper shows its first picture only, and no extension runs to draw a wallpaper.
entries.ready_note: Apps provide wallpapers through their manifest (still or day, checked against the package at install), Settings lists them, and a day wallpaper on screen steps through all of its pictures with the clock (shell.rs app_wallpapers caches every picture; wallpaper_types::day_of and current_id pick the one for the minute). BifrOSt runs no extension code in the wallpaper layer, so a wallpaper that draws itself live (the reference extension model, default.metallib) is not offered.

entries.name: WallpaperFoundation
entries.note: Wallpaper selection and cover fit are in springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_page.rs and wallpaper_schedule.rs; no SDK wallpaper API.
entries.ready_note: Wallpaper selection, cover fit and the day schedule are in springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_page.rs and wallpaper_schedule.rs. No SDK wallpaper API.

entries.name: WallpaperServices
entries.note: Wallpaper changes go through the shell's wallpaper page and schedule; there is no wallpaper service process.
entries.ready_note: Wallpaper changes and the day/night schedule run in the shell (wallpaper_page.rs, wallpaper_schedule.rs). There is no separate wallpaper service process, by design.

entries.name: WallpaperSettingsUI
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Wallpaper picker page in springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_page.rs (grid, cover fit, dimming) is the Settings wallpaper UI; its unit tests run on the VM.

entries.name: WallpaperTypes
entries.note: Built 2026-10-17: typed kinds (still, day) and the picture rules in springboard/src/shell/wallpaper_types.rs; manifest keys wallpaper_kind and wallpapers are parsed and checked against the package at install.
entries.ready_note: Kinds, picture paths, day slices (through wallpaper_schedule) and the install-time package check are tested.

entries.name: WatchListKit
entries.note: Apple Watch companion lists; BifrOSt has no watch companion.

entries.name: WatchdogClient
entries.note: Process watchdog is systemd: RuntimeWatchdogSec and RebootWatchdogSec in /etc/systemd/system.conf.d/bifrost-watchdog.conf (springboard/src/installer/plan.rs); no app-facing client API.
entries.ready_note: Per-service side: the SDK watchdog module reads WATCHDOG_USEC and pings systemd with WATCHDOG=1 over NOTIFY_SOCKET at half the timeout. Machine-wide side: RuntimeWatchdogSec and RebootWatchdogSec in bifrost-watchdog.conf (installer plan).

entries.name: WatchdogServiceManagement
entries.note: Watchdog service registration is systemd unit management; BifrOSt sets watchdog timeouts in the system manager, with no app-facing API.
entries.ready_note: Per-service side: the SDK watchdog module reads WATCHDOG_USEC and pings systemd with WATCHDOG=1 over NOTIFY_SOCKET at half the timeout. Machine-wide side: RuntimeWatchdogSec and RebootWatchdogSec in bifrost-watchdog.conf (installer plan).

entries.name: WeatherAnalytics
entries.note: Analytics for weather use; BifrOSt does not mirror analytics collection.

entries.name: WeatherCore
entries.note: Forecast model and parsing live in springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs and the Weather app; no SDK weather module.
entries.ready_note: Forecast model, parsing, units, air quality and the store live in springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs.

entries.name: WeatherDaemon
entries.note: Built 2026-10-17: the shell refreshes the shared summary for the Today widget and lock screen with no app window open. Refresher (springboard/src/shell/weather/mod.rs) asks once an hour from the shell tick and again on every wake (screen_woke), on a worker thread; data::refresh_summary reuses a forecast cached under 15 minutes, and does nothing until the weather app has saved a place.
entries.ready_note: Refresher due/wake schedule and the refresh_summary service are tested; the shell tick and wake hooks call them.

entries.name: WeatherData
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Forecast fetch and parsing in springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs, used by the Weather app; data comes from Open-Meteo, not the Apple service.

entries.name: WeatherFoundation
entries.note: Forecast data types live in springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs; no SDK API for other apps.
entries.ready_note: Forecast data types and parsing in springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs. No SDK API for other apps (see WeatherKit row).

entries.name: WeatherResources
entries.note: Weather glyphs and icons are in springboard/src/shell/weather/glyph.rs.
entries.ready_note: Sky glyphs and weather icons are drawn in springboard/src/shell/weather/glyph.rs and tested there.

entries.name: WebContentAnalysis
entries.note: Apple Screen Time web content analysis with Apple-maintained allow lists; Apple account service.

entries.name: WebContentRestrictions
entries.note: Apple Screen Time web content restrictions and Apple-maintained filter lists; Apple account service.

entries.name: WebFilterDNS
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: DNS-level and URL-level web filtering decisions: the DNS proxy policy (most specific domain rule wins, refuse with NXDOMAIN or forward, one question matched) and the URL filter with allow or block rules and fail-closed. Pure decision models; the process that sits in front of the resolver passes each query to them.

entries.name: WebPrivacy
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Link tracking protection: tracking and campaign query parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ...) are removed from addresses (the browser strips them from every address the person chooses), and a tracker host list blocks third-party requests to listed hosts, with person-added and allowed hosts. All local; nothing is reported or fetched. Private click measurement (advertising attribution reported to the reference servers) is not mirrored. The browser engine gives no request hooks, so the host list is a model that is not applied to page requests.

entries.name: Welcome
entries.note: Apple account, iCloud and Apple service onboarding screens. BifrOSt's own first-run setup steps are in springboard/src/setup.rs.

entries.name: WellnessUI
entries.note: Apple Health wellness UI for wearables; BifrOSt has no wearable health data.

entries.name: WiFiAnalytics
entries.note: Apple-internal Wi-Fi analytics; BifrOSt does not collect Wi-Fi telemetry, so there is no counterpart.

entries.name: WiFiCloudSyncEngine
entries.note: Apple-account Wi-Fi network sync across devices; BifrOSt has no iCloud-style sync service for Wi-Fi profiles.

entries.name: WiFiPeerToPeer
entries.note: n/a: Apple Wireless Direct Link (AWDL), the proprietary peer-to-peer Wi-Fi used by AirDrop and Continuity, with no open equivalent. BifrOSt requests access-point and ad-hoc links through its own wlan service (sdk wlan_service).

entries.name: WiFiPolicy
entries.note: n/a: Apple Wi-Fi network-quality telemetry and cloud assets. Index: ThreeBars Core Data model and ThreeBarsXPCService (network quality scoring database), WiFiCloudAssetsXPCService with beaconData.db and a cloud-defaults plist, default_factors_1650.pb. BifrOSt scans, joins and auto-joins locally (src/net/wifi.rs) and sends no network-quality data.

entries.name: WiFiSettingsKit
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreWLAN; from SDK matrix core-wlan.json
entries.ready_note: Wi-Fi settings page (springboard/src/shell/wifi_page.rs) over NetworkManager (nmcli), the Arch networkmanager package the installer enables.

entries.name: WiFiVelocity
entries.note: Apple-internal Wi-Fi performance tuning service with no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: WidgetObservation
entries.note: Widget state is kept by the shell (springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs, today.rs); no app-facing observation API.
entries.ready_note: An app can list its own widgets with what the person arranged (on screen, size, configurable, current title: widgets) and observe one (observe), then receives a visibility event when the person adds, removes or resizes it in Edit Widgets. The shell keeps the widget state; the SDK client has widgets, observe and Event::Visibility.

entries.name: WidgetRenderer
entries.note: Widgets are drawn by the shell (springboard/src/shell/widgets/mod.rs); apps cannot supply widget rendering.
entries.ready_note: The shell draws every desktop widget (springboard/src/shell/widgets/*.rs, mod.rs). Apps cannot supply widget rendering, which is a known limit.

entries.name: WindowManagement
entries.note: Window placement and tiling live in the shell (springboard/src/shell/desk.rs, desk_occlusion.rs); no app-facing API.
entries.ready_note: Window placement, tiling into halves and quarters, snap zones and maximize live in bifrost-wm (wm/src/tiling.rs, wm/src/wm.rs). The shell desk code (springboard/src/shell/desk.rs) draws the desktop windows.

entries.name: WindowManager
entries.note: Window management is in the shell (springboard/src/shell/desk.rs); apps get their own toplevels, and there is no app-facing window manager API.
entries.ready_note: The window server bifrost-wm (springboard/wm) owns placement, stacking, focus, hit testing, move and resize grabs, maximize and tiling (wm/src/wm.rs, tiling.rs). Apps get their own toplevels; there is no app-facing window manager API.

entries.name: WirelessCoexManager
entries.note: Apple Wi-Fi and Bluetooth coexistence power tables for Apple chips; Apple hardware.

entries.name: WirelessDiagnostics
entries.note: n/a: Apple Wireless Diagnostics (AWD) telemetry. Index: libAWDProtobuf* libraries (Bluetooth, Location, FaceTime and iMessage), AWDMetadata.bin and hotship.config, i.e. metric protobufs and an upload configuration. BifrOSt's own Wireless Diagnostics app (apps/wireless-diagnostics-desktop) reads the local link and shows a report; nothing is uploaded.

entries.name: WirelessProximity
entries.note: Apple device proximity framework for Apple devices (Continuity); Apple hardware and services.

entries.name: WorkflowEditor
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: The workflow editor is the step editor of the Shortcuts app (widget.rs: typing and editing a step's text in place, name entry, search, gallery and folders) and of Automator (window.rs); their tests exercise editing, refusing empty or duplicate names and keeping edits.

entries.name: WorkflowKit
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: The workflow engine: the shortcut file format (shortcuts.rs round trips), the flow runner with variables, If and Repeat blocks and step output passing (shortcuts/flow.rs), the app host that performs or refuses steps (runner.rs) and the SDK's sequential workflow model with pause, step and stop (sdk workflow.rs).

entries.name: WorkflowResponsiveness
entries.note: n/a: Apple performance telemetry; the resources are WorkflowPlists/*.plist latency budgets for named Apple features (dictation, the assistant, chat flows, notification catch-up) that feed Apple diagnostics, and BifrOSt collects no such telemetry (its own timing is core/src/signpost.rs).

entries.name: WorkflowUI
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: The views of the workflow editor are the Shortcuts window (widget.rs: gallery grid, sidebar, step rows, result panel) and the Automator canvas (draw.rs); their tests cover layout, hit testing and drawing.

entries.name: WorkflowUICore
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Internal split of the workflow editor UI (shared view state and the action field models): BifrOSt keeps these in the Shortcuts widget module and the Automator model and action modules, whose tests cover them.

entries.name: WorkflowUIServices
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: The services that show a workflow's run to the person: the in-app run host with notification and result panel (runner.rs), the picker and onscreen-context queries other apps use (automation.rs) and the reminder and login-item services (services.rs).

entries.name: WorkoutAnnouncements
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: fitness services are not mirrored

entries.name: WorldClockAppIntents
entries.note: private framework, owner AppIntents; from SDK matrix app-intents.json The App Intents framework layer is ready (see the AppIntents row); this Apple app's own intents are not ported.
entries.ready_note: The Clock app declares the world-clock-time and next-alarm App Intents (clock/intent.rs) as runnable shortcuts; the tests cover the declarations, city lookup ignoring case, daylight saving, the device-time default and rejection of unknown intents and cities.

entries.name: WritingTools
entries.note: Apple Intelligence writing assistance; BifrOSt has no OS-level writing model service.

entries.name: WritingToolsUI
entries.note: Apple Intelligence writing assistance UI; BifrOSt has no OS-level writing model service.

entries.name: XARTRecovery
entries.note: n/a: Apple silicon secure-storage hardware (xART anti-replay tokens held with the Secure Enclave); the bundle holds only Info.plist and version.plist and BifrOSt runs on Arch with no such hardware.

entries.name: XCTAutomationSupport
entries.note: Xcode UI automation internals; BifrOSt drives apps through its control sockets and MCP tools.

entries.name: XCTTargetBootstrap
entries.note: Xcode test bootstrap internals; BifrOSt tests run with cargo test.

entries.name: XCTestSupport
entries.note: Xcode test-runner internals; BifrOSt tests run with cargo test.

entries.name: XGBoostFramework
entries.note: Apple internal XGBoost model runtime for Apple ML models; Apple ML, not mirrored.

entries.name: XOJIT
entries.note: Apple JIT for Xcode and playground tooling; Apple developer tooling, no BifrOSt job.

entries.name: XOJITExecutor
entries.note: Apple JIT executor for Xcode and playground tooling; Apple developer tooling.

entries.name: XPCDistributed
entries.note: n/a: Apple-only proprietary cross-device transport (XPC carried between a user's Apple devices); the bundle holds only Info.plist and a logging subsystem plist, and no open equivalent exists. BifrOSt's app IPC is the control socket in sdk/src/control.rs.

entries.name: XPCSupport
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: XPC plumbing for apps and their helpers; BifrOSt's inter-process layer is the app control endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0 over an owner-only Unix socket with peer-credential checks, sdk control.rs), covered by its tests.

entries.name: XQuery
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Built in core/src/xml_query.rs: an XML parser (elements, attributes, CDATA, entities, depth and size limits) and a path-query evaluator (steps, // and .., predicates with comparisons and and/or/not, count/string/exists/contains/starts-with/name/position/last). The XQuery language beyond paths (FLWOR, constructors, arithmetic) is not supported and is refused with an error.

entries.name: XprotectFramework
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found Lead 2026-10-17: not ready: malware_scan is not called on the shell open path yet.

entries.name: ZeoliteFramework
entries.note: n/a: Apple on-device ML evaluation tooling; the only dependent in the index is ZeoliteEvalExtension.appex (an evaluation harness extension) and the bundle holds only Info.plist. BifrOSt ships no Apple-style on-device model.

entries.name: ZeoliteLanguage
entries.note: n/a: Apple on-device language model evaluation support, paired with ZeoliteFramework; the bundle holds only Info.plist and the sole dependent is ZeoliteEvalExtension.appex. BifrOSt ships no Apple-style on-device model.

entries.name: yara
entries.note: private framework, no plausible owner found
entries.ready_note: Built in core/src/pattern_rules.rs: a rule language with text patterns (nocase, wide, ascii, fullword), hex patterns with wildcards, counts, offsets, filesize, any/all/N of sets and and/or/not. Hex jumps, regular expressions and modules are not supported and are refused at compile time.
